finding_info.title: Defender for Endpoint - Outbound connection to known command-and-control server
finding_info.desc: powershell.exe on ws-fin-042.contoso.corp established an outbound TCP connection to 195.201.59.127:4443, a known command-and-control infrastructure node geolocated to DE (ASN 24940). The connecting process was spawned from cmd.exe with an obfuscated, base64-encoded command line consistent with the Bovter reverse-shell pattern. MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.001 (Web Protocols), T1095 (Non-Application Layer Protocol), T1573 (Encrypted Channel).
